about_the_game:
YOU ARE THE LAW IN THESE STREETS

In Nerd City, where crime, lies, and chaos reign, your checkpoint is the last line of defense. But this isn't just about traffic duty. Your family has been kidnapped by a ruthless Cartel. Saving them depends on your sharp eyes, your ability to detect lies, and the difficult choices you make.

🔍 DETAILED INSPECTION AND INTERROGATION

Classic document verification and discrepancy detection mechanics meet an atmospheric 3D world. Every vehicle approaching your checkpoint is a puzzle waiting to be solved.

  • Document Control: Cross-check driver's licenses, vehicle registration, insurance, and license plates. An expired date, a typo in a name, or mismatched data could be the sign of a major crime.

  • Suspicion & Search: Is the driver nervous? Is their story inconsistent? Interrogate them, order them out, and search the trunk to uncover illegal goods (weapons, drugs, contraband).

⚖️ THE VERDICT: FINE, CUFFS, OR FREEDOM?

Once the inspection is over, you are the judge. How will you use the authority given to you by the law?

  • 📝 Issue Fine: Missing documents? Broken taillight? Write the ticket and earn revenue for the department.

  • 👮 Arrest: Found a wanted criminal or a fake ID? Slap on the handcuffs and bring them to justice.

  • 👋 Release: Is everything in order? Raise the barrier and let them proceed.

  • 🚫 Impound: Is the vehicle unsafe? Call the tow truck and send it straight to the impound lot.

WHAT IS THE PRICE OF YOUR CONSCIENCE?

When Cartel members pass through your checkpoint, the game shifts from a logic puzzle to a battle for survival. You will face bribes, threats, and moral dilemmas.

  • Dirty Deals: Accept the bribe to gather ransom money quickly. However, your honor will be stained, and your reputation will crumble.

  • Integrity & Price: Reject the bribe to gain fame and promotion. But remember, the Cartel never forgets.

KEY FEATURES

  • Full Authority: Stop, Search, Fine, Arrest, Tow, or Release.

  • Detective Work: Gameplay based on attention to detail, logic, and observation.

  • Noir Atmosphere: Gritty underworld with a dynamic day cycle and rainy city vibes.

  • Rich Story & Multiple Endings: Every choice shapes the narrative and the finale.

  • Family & Economy: Manage finances to pay the ransom or upgrade equipment.

    The scales of justice are in your hands. How much are you willing to tip them to save your family?

short_description: In the rainy checkpoint of Nerd City, you are a traffic officer racing against time to save your family from the Cartel. Inspect documents and make the call: Issue fines, arrest criminals, impound vehicles, or release the innocent. Every decision shapes your family's fate. The law or your blood?
